nuggets.text: The Bobcats bring 13 straight home wins into Saturday's home opener at Peden Stadium.
The Bobcats have won seven straight bowl games, most recently a 17-10 Frisco Bowl win over UNLV.
John Hauser, the Bobcats' 31st head coach, was a Division III All-American at Wittenberg in 2002.
As defensive coordinator, John Hauser's unit held Miami (OH) to three points in the 2024 MAC title game, a 38-3 Bobcats win.
The Bobcats won 40 games from 2022 through 2025, a program record for any four-season span.
The Bobcats' first 11-win season came in 2024, capped by a 30-27 Cure Bowl win over Jax State.
Ohio's Marching 110 has been billed as The Most Exciting Band in the Land since 1967.
The Bobcats have played since 1894, but their first bowl win didn't come until 2011, 24-23 over Utah State.
The Marching 110 is named for its original size, but the band now has about 250 members.
The Bobcats faced QB Anthony Colandrea in back-to-back games: with UNLV in the Frisco Bowl, then with Nebraska last week.
